title: Chapter 155
text:
Han Xiao was looking forward to becoming a participant of the main mission and joining as a partner. The mission should be different from the other players.

Overmera seemed to be his hidden enemy. Han Xiao rubbed his chin and said to himself, "I'll see when the time comes. I'm not in a hurry now. This is just a small territory."

He looked at the interface and saw that he had accumulated more than one million experience points. Blue Star had nineteen novice villages. Excluding Andrea's six, Big Horn Village and Green Valley Town, he still had eleven chances to earn profession change skills. It was more than enough for him to reach Level 60! After that, he could go to some dangerous places and collect rare talents, skills, and machinery. That was why there was a saying, "Max level is just the beginning." Although he did not have a level cap in the version, it was not the most cost-effective to just keep leveling up.

Since he had a huge channel of experience points, Han Xiao was generous and used the experience points to level up his skills.

Potential points could not be used carelessly, but experience points did not matter.

He directly raised three skills to max level. They were [Flaming Will], [Overload], and [Continuous Slide Shot]. These three combat skills were very important. Their explosive power was increased by another level. If [Flaming Will] and [Overload] were activated at the same time, it was possible for the Ghost Gauss Sniper Rifle to deal more than 2,000 damage. The three skills were maxed out and brought him three Potential Points. He had accumulated 24 Potential Points. He saved them and did not want to use them carelessly.

With the rest of the experience points, Han Xiao performed a few knowledge fusion and randomly obtained new blueprints. This time, there was a blueprint that was not bad.

["Sunworm" Portable Flamethrower], continuous flame damage. The most important thing was that it was small in size and had a large attack range. It could be carried around or installed as a small module in armor or robots.

A player who had accepted the town patrol mission suddenly ran over in a panic and shouted, "I found an army. They are approaching and triggered a mission!"

The players in Green Valley Town suddenly became restless and checked the interface.

Han Xiao suddenly raised his eyebrows. He had also received a mission!

You have triggered the Random Mission [Green Valley Town Invasion].

Mission Introduction: Green Valley Town, which is controlled by Overmera, is very close to Black Pine Settlement, which is controlled by Lu Cheng. There has been constant friction between them. Now, Lu Cheng is leading his troops to invade Green Valley Town again. You can choose to help Overmera defend Green Valley Town or help Lu Cheng attack. Please choose your side.

Mission Requirements: Inform Balsas and protect Green Valley Town. Alternatively, join Lu Cheng's team and attack Green Valley Town. PS: Cannot be changed after choosing a faction.]

Mission Reward: 1. Choose Green Valley Town and complete the defense. Receive 12000 EXP and 3,000 Aquamarine Dollars.

2. Chose Lu Cheng and completed the attack. Received 10000 EXP.

"I can't believe I also received a newbie mission."

Han Xiao couldn't help but laugh. He didn't care about this little reward, but Lu Cheng in the quest prompt caught his attention. If he remembered correctly, Lu Cheng was Old Man Lu's son, a rogue warlord in the Southern Continent.

Old Man Lu's quest for the four blueprints was to be received from Lu Cheng. Han Xiao immediately made a decision. As long as he came in contact with Lu Cheng, he would know when the hidden quest would begin.

He had been drooling over the four rare blueprints for a long time.

"Let's wait and see if the leader is Lu Cheng himself or his subordinate." Han Xiao took out his sniper rifle and oiled it. He was very relaxed, completely different from the busy players around him.

This urgent mission made the players move. Some people directly chose to defend Green Valley Town, which had a higher reward, and went to inform the guards. Some players just watched.

Balsas received the notification and jumped out of his lover's bed in surprise. He hurriedly put on his clothes and quickly walked to the town's watchtower. The watchtower was built with stones and bricks, and the top was covered with weeds as a canopy. He picked up his binoculars and saw smoke rising on the road in the distance. An armed convoy was quickly approaching. The armed forces were several times stronger than Green Valley Town.

"Damn it, those bastards from Black Pine are here again!" Balsas cursed. His triangular eyes were very gloomy.

Green Valley Town was only a branch of Overmera, and Lu Cheng was a local rogue warlord in the Southern Continent. His influence was even greater. Black Pine was Lu Cheng's headquarters, and Green Valley Town was located dozens of miles away from Black Pine. It was located at a strategic location. Lu Cheng had been eyeing it for a long time. He had tried to invade it a few times, but he did not expect to launch an attack today.

Xiao Rui came to Balsas's side and pointed at the black mass of players outside the town. "Don't worry, don't we have cannon fodder?"

Balsas's eyes lit up. With this group of strange undying refugees, he could offset Lu Cheng's advantage in armed forces!

Balsas called his assistant and ordered, "You go and tell the refugees outside that I need them to resist Lu Cheng's army. As long as they complete my orders, they will all be given money."

Xiao Rui added, "Don't give them too much. Their lives are worthless."

"I understand." This group of refugees was the best cannon fodder, a trump card that could defeat Lu Cheng. Balsas revealed a sinister smile. Luck was on his side!

… …

Lu Cheng sat in the middle of a tank with a serious expression. This army had more than 60 off-road armored vehicles equipped with machine guns and rocket launchers. There were also hundreds of fully armed elite soldiers following behind. They were all qualified soldiers who had undergone training. They could at least fight one against three, and they knew how to cooperate with each other. They were not ordinary rogues.

Lu Cheng had been eyeing Green Valley Town for a long time. This town was located at a strategic pass in the Black Pine settlement. How could he allow others to sleep there? Only by taking down the town would he have no worries.

"This time, we must take down Green Valley Town."

As the troops neared Green Valley Town, Lu Cheng immediately saw the densely packed crowd surrounding the town. They were dressed in rags and looked like a group of refugees guarding the town.

Lu Cheng's face immediately sank, and a trace of anger flashed in his eyes. "Despicable bastards, using refugees as cannon fodder!"

He let the armored convoy stop far away from the town, just outside the range of the town's machine guns. The smoke and dust quickly dissipated, and the tracks left behind on the dirt road emitted a burnt smell. The friction caused the air to distort.

The players who chose to stand guard gripped their weapons tightly and waited. The cold armored vehicles and the densely packed gun barrels made many people a little nervous. They secretly swallowed their saliva, and the sweat on their foreheads glistened under the sunlight.

Many of the spectating players were puzzled. Didn't they say that they could choose their faction? It seemed like they were about to fight, and there was no time to choose …

"Balsas, you want to use these pitiful people to block my gunfire?" Lu Cheng took out a loudspeaker, and his voice spread far and wide. The town could hear it clearly. "My people can easily tear them apart. Do you want me to use my blood to color your territory?"

Balsas popped his head out from the town's wall with a cold smile.

Lu Cheng frowned and looked at the group of refugees in ragged clothes. He said in a deep voice, "I will give you a chance to leave. You don't have to die."

But he found that the refugees did not waver after a while.

"Are these people not afraid of death?"

Lu Cheng was surprised to find that these refugees did not have a trace of fear on their faces. He hesitated and did not order to attack.

Balsas could vaguely guess the values of this group of refugees. They disregarded life and only cared about profit. When he saw Lu Cheng hesitating, he was somewhat pleased. Furthermore, he looked down on Lu Cheng's indecisiveness and mocked in a low voice, "Soft-hearted."

Worrying about the lives of the refugees and delaying the battle, Lu Cheng's choice was very stupid in Balsas' eyes.

Balsas laughed grimly. Just as he was about to order the refugees to counterattack, he suddenly realized that Black Phantom, who had been idle all this time, had moved.

Han Xiao turned his neck, stood up, and walked slowly to the center of the confrontation. He instantly attracted the attention of both sides and the players. He crossed his arms and said loudly, "Give me some face. If you want to fight, do it tomorrow!"

With the enhancement of energy, his voice was not inferior to the loudspeaker. Everyone was shocked.

"Why is he interfering?" Balsas hurriedly swallowed the order that was about to come out of his mouth.

Lu Cheng was stunned. He looked for a while and said, "Black Phantom? Why is this guy here? "

The commanders of both sides were afraid and ordered the troops to put down their guns. The atmosphere of the confrontation dissipated instantly.

The players were shocked. They were still at the stage of figuring out the background of Blue Star. From the mission introduction, they knew that Balsas and Lu Cheng were warlords with a strong background. However, Black Phantom was the only one who stood up, and these two warlords were afraid of him. The players' curiosity was immediately aroused.

Black Phantom stopped the battle that was about to break out with one sentence and made the two warlords feel like they were facing a strong enemy. What was his background?

Look at this line, "Give me some face." How high of a position did he have to have the right to say this? The scariest thing was that the two warlords really stopped fighting. How much weight did his face hold?

Wait, these NPCs all know Black Phantom. How famous is he on this planet? Is it to the point where he can show his face wherever he goes?

"Is this the legendary face fruit?"
